data.gender_notes: Lucjan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Loukios, meaning 'bright, shining, and light'. In Christian tradition, Lucjan can be interpreted as a symbol of hope and enlightenment. The name Lucjan carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lucjan usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in spiritual darkness.
data.etymology: Lucjan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lucjan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Lucjan holds a rich history in various cultures beyond its Christian roots, such as in Poland where it has been a popular name for centuries. In Eastern European folklore, Lucjan represents a lively and spirited character, often associated with jesters, farmers, or merrymakers. This playful yet profound meaning highlights the importance of lightness, joy, and the celebration of life in our everyday experiences.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lucjan holds an intriguing spiritual significance in Christianity for being a source of light and hope. The name reflects the belief that, just as Lucjan illuminates the world around him with his shining spirit, so does God bring light to our lives in times of darkness. The name therefore symbolizes the transformative power of faith and the belief that there is always hope, no matter the Trials and tribulations we may face.
